goal: Evidence-driven GPPO/world system with component retention decisions
primary_question: Frozen model combination vs public-only rule under identical guard on observed native25-action prefixes

arms.frozen_model: frozen native GPPO+world use_events=True plus unchanged guard
arms.public_rule: public-priority-edf-nearest-v1 plus same guard; zero learned-model calls

rule.noop: retained legal candidate ranked after valid allocations; selected when no allocation survives guard; no mask deletion
rule.probability_carrier: deterministic rank weights for common guard interface, not calibrated model probabilities

matrix.order: parent/repeat ascending; frozen_model first iff (parent_index+repeat)%2==0; 12 pairs each order
matrix.prefix_limitation: Common saved states were generated by historical learned behavior; this is conditional continuation, not full-episode default-system evidence

primary.discount: k0 first post-prefix step, native termination without bootstrap
primary.aggregation: 3 repeat paired differences within parent, then 8 equal parent means
primary.effect_units: absolute native preference utility, not percentage points
primary.threshold_basis: Prospective engineering criterion for retaining added system complexity; not estimated from this new comparison and not a power guarantee

decision_rules.lower_ci_above_0.01: continue component attribution stage planning only
decision_rules.upper_ci_below_0.01: no support for minimum worthwhile gain in this matrix; freeze current model scheme absent a concrete documented gap
decision_rules.otherwise: uncertain about worthwhile gain; no automatic sample expansion, training or metric change

secondary: task completed/all vs original cohort arrival/host
legal candidate counts before and after guard
first action divergence while actual pre-state hashes coincide; feedback only for executed actions
model/rule invocation counts, setup and selector/environment/whole-run wall time, communication if native ledger supports measurement
candidate_acceptance: Public legality, selected executor acceptance, and terminal consequence differences reported separately. Two-arm initial commands count as both accepted evidence only when pre-env and public hashes match and both actual feedback is accepted; this does not certify unexecuted candidates.
fair_cost: Each arm run new; alternate order; model encode/world/actor counted before and after calls, rule calls separately. World not invoked in rule. Shared prefix deserialization excluded from online selector timing and explicitly disclosed; model load setup separately counted. Compare measured selection and branch costs without assuming all overhead is model work.
all_stage_scope: Stage1 only. No automatic stage2/3/4/5 dynamic runs. R/K/heartbeat/event recipe closures retained.
artifact_requirements: actual executable runner and authorized same-ledger extension command
pure tests with stub actual entry execution and failure retention
